hook: Riemann zeta zeros come closer than 0.7892 of the average spacing, proved without assumptions.

readout.label: Proven small-gap constant lambda_0 for zeta zeros

summary: Selberg showed a positive proportion of Riemann zeta zeros sit closer than the average spacing by some factor lambda_0 below 1. Using an unconditional version of Montgomery's pair correlation method, Lamzouri proves lambda_0 = 0.7892 works, versus 1 minus 2.36e-6 before. The statement says a positive proportion exists, not how large it is.
title: The distribution of small gaps between zeros of the Riemann zeta function
